subject: science
passage: Arctic terns make the longest known migration of any animal. Each year, these small gray-and-white seabirds ______ from their nesting grounds in the far north to the edge of Antarctica and back again. Because they follow winding routes over the ocean, a single round trip can cover more than 70,000 kilometers.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The subject of the verb is "seabirds," a plural noun ("these small gray-and-white seabirds"). A plural subject needs a plural verb, and the passage describes something that happens "each year," so the simple present "fly" fits.
explanation.A: Correct. The plural verb "fly" agrees with the plural subject "seabirds."
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Flies" is a singular verb, but the subject "seabirds" is plural.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Is flying" is singular, but the subject "seabirds" is plural.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Has flown" is singular, but the subject "seabirds" is plural.
